mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic activity and corporate earnings, directly driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved profit visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds its 12-month rolling average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and decreases in UNRATE signal aggressive monetary tightening amid labor market strength, causing equity valuation compression and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur in <40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction term shows positive coefficient in regression.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 3% annualized) indicates robust consumer and business spending, driving sustained corporate earnings growth that lifts S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 > 3% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% annually triggers anticipated Federal Reserve rate hikes, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (y/y).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated retail sales (RSAFS) reflect strong consumer demand, directly boosting corporate revenues and earnings growth, which translates to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month rolling average.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal synchronized demand and supply expansion, accelerating economic momentum and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in <40% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO rise, or interaction term shows negative coefficient in regression.

mechanism_narrative: Robust employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly) indicates sustained labor market strength, increasing consumer spending power and corporate hiring, which elevates S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k.
